description: Use this when the user wants a new sudoku puzzle to play or print (sudoku generator, printable sudoku with answers, easy sudoku for kids, hard sudoku). Generates a classic 9x9 sudoku at easy, medium or hard difficulty, checked by a solver for a single solution, playable in the chat with pencil notes, plus a printable PDF with the answer key. Does not solve a sudoku the user already has, explain solving strategies, or make 4x4, 6x6 or variant sudoku.

difficulty.description: easy (37-38 givens, solvable with simple elimination), medium (30-32 givens, still solvable with singles), hard (24-30 givens, checked to require a technique beyond singles). Default medium. Example: hard

paper.description: Paper size for the printable PDF: letter (US, default) or a4. Example: a4

seed.description: Optional layout seed (1-999999). The same inputs and seed always give the same puzzle; pass a different seed for a new layout. Example: 2024

title.description: Title printed on the puzzle and PDF. Example: "Friday Brain Teaser"

name: generate_sudoku
